title: Changing Tiers Within a Wellness Membership
content:
An existing Wellness Membership moves from one tier to another by a tier change.

## The rule

A tier change takes effect from the next billing period; dues and session allotments of the new tier apply from that period. A move to a lower tier before the commitment end date is allowed only where the current tier allows a move down during the commitment. A move to a tier that requires a medical clearance needs a clearance on file. The commitment end date does not change on a tier change.

## Questions and answers

**From when do the new tier's dues apply?** From the next billing period, together with the new tier's session allotment.

**Does a tier change restart or extend the commitment?** No. The commitment end date does not change on a tier change.

**Whose term decides whether a move down before the commitment end date is allowed?** The term of the tier the member currently holds. A move to a lower tier before the commitment end date is allowed only where that tier allows it.

**Does moving to a tier that requires a medical clearance need anything on file?** Yes, a clearance on file.

## Hypothetical cases

| Current tier | Requested tier | Before the commitment end date | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| any tier | a higher tier | Yes | it takes effect from the next billing period, and the commitment end date stays as it is |
| A tier whose term does not allow a move down during the commitment | a lower tier | Yes | not allowed |
| any tier | a tier that requires a medical clearance | either | a clearance on file is needed |
